Three questions, one switch

Every page answers one of three questions for the scenario selected at the top. Pages follow the framework: scenario ladder (rows of experiments), value channels (why a battery earns), and audience (policy maker or trader).

Framework the pages hang on
Scenario ladder S0 today S1 + SoC carry-over, wear cost, 10–90% window S2 + weekly load shape S3 + solar with weather draw S4 + adaptive generators Each rung re-pretrains generators and has its own no-battery baseline.
Value channels C1 within-day spread C2 between-day shift C3 scarcity peaks C4 uncertainty / imbalance C5 strategic response Only C1 is open in S0.
Reading rules Every effect is battery minus the same-seed baseline. Solid = 95% CI excludes zero; hatched = it does not. Units are relative only: % of the no-battery market, or yield per MW. A scenario that has not run is shown as dashed, never as zero.

Policy outcomes not yet measurable

Emissions: needs fuel types (S3 solar). Curtailment avoided: needs solar (S3). Long-run generator response: needs S4. Reliability: unserved demand averages about 1 MWh a day (max 18). Needs its own paired panel.

Mechanism:
Mechanism · S0 · 25 MW · 8 h · seed 43 · mean of 20 eval days

Three trades a day, using under half the tank

The battery charges at 00:00, 20:00 and 21:00 and sells at 10:00, 14:00 and 19:00. State of charge stays between 24% and 63%. Prices are % of the no-battery daily mean.

Health:
Model health · S0

Is the learner good enough to trust the numbers?

Each result elsewhere is only as good as the PPO battery that produced it. This page checks it against a direct schedule search and checks that the generators settled before the battery arrived.

Learned vs achievable · spot check, 4 of 200 batteries

PPO net revenue as % of CMA-ES open-loop schedule

84% ok 75 MW · 4 h · s43

Line at 80% = proposed warning threshold. CMA-ES ran once per case and may itself sit in a local optimum, so these are lower bounds on the gap. Full panel needs CMA-ES on all 200 batteries (about 25 min on 8 cores).

Seed spread

1.3–4.5 pts Standard deviation of yield per MW across 10 seeds, per size. One battery trained per seed, so this mixes market luck with training luck.

Known model limits

Terminal penalty 80/MWh, below the cap of 90. Daily SoC reset to 50%. Perfect foresight of demand. Generators frozen: no response shown. Removed from S1 onward where marked.
